The Only Gacha Ever

Oh boy where do I even START when it comes to this godforsaken game... I've been playing since 1.0 and have been consistently logging in practically every day like a lunatic. I am deep in this shit man.

That's not to say I am forcing myself to play though (or....am i....), I genuinely love the world this game has to offer and I have a lot of fond memories playing events with randos I met in co-op. I think my favorite aspect about this game though comes from the exploration. Honestly, without the open-world I probably would've dropped this game early on, but I personally think they've delivered with the environments in every region, so I'm still in the trenches 6 years later.
